items.title: Leonard Bocage Interview, 1972-03-24
items.q: They called her Miss Cus, which they go play for on Saturday night.

ctx.x: Yeah, he could squeal. Yeah, he squeal like I don't know what with that clarinet. Yeah. He used to make me laugh with a lady up in Kenna. They called her Miss Cus, which they go play for on Saturday night. So, John would come in and say, Miss Cus, she said, what is it, John? I said, you got any raw eggs? She said, yeah, John. I said, give me two. John would take two of them raw eggs, and he'd suck them down, and he'd tell those red olives, and I'm going to blow you off the bandstand for the night. I don't know.
He'd suck the raw eggs, then.
